remarks: Enjoy this 2 bedroom townhouse, hardwood floors throughout, full bath in upper floor, half bath main level, washer/dryer for your convenience. 1 parking space assigned. Heat included in rent.  Central A/C. Cozy kitchen, tile floor, with dishwasher, electric stove, Refrigerator, Microwave. Nice size closet, Plenty of windows with window treatments. Walking distance the all the nightlife of Harbor Point. Complete Rental Application ,Good Credit, 2 Months Security Deposit. References required, One dog allowed no more than 20 Lbs with proof of all vaccinations required.
